differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the buttons, creating a tighter composition.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further back, showing more of the surrounding tiles.
differences.fix: Move the camera closer to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: Deep shadows are visible in the crevices between the tiles, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: Crevice shadows are very faint and bright, making the scene look flat.
differences.fix: Darken the ambient occlusion and contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: The yellow and blue buttons have highly saturated, vibrant colors.
differences.b_observable: The yellow and blue buttons appear washed out and desaturated.
differences.fix: Increase color saturation on the button materials.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera distance and focal length to match the closer framing of the reference, and deepen the contact shadows between tiles to eliminate the flat appearance.
